'''Donalo Sandomere''' is a [[Tear|Tairen]] [[Asha'man]].  

==Physical Description==
Donalo Sandomere is a grizzled man, with the creased face of a farmer, but his gray-streaked beard is oiled and trimmed to a point, in the style of [[Tear|Tairen]] nobility. He wears a garnet in his left ear.

==Abilities==
Donalo is among the strongest Asha'man, described a bit weaker in [[saidin|''saidin'']]'' ''only to Rand, Logain and Narishma. He has the [[Talent]] to read residues and so he is able to track and open a gateway to a place were a former gateway was opened before.

==Activities==
Sandomere is in the audience when [[Rand al'Thor]] addresses the Asha'man,{{ref/book|6|42}} and he participates in the battle at [[Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}} He watches Rand select the Asha'man to accompany him back to [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|7|prologue}}

He is one of the Asha'man in Rand's army in [[Illian]]. Rand notices him, and thinks he looks familiar.{{verify}}  When the fifty-one sisters sent to the [[Black Tower]] are captured and [[Bonding|bonded]] by the Asha'man, he bonds [[Ayako Norsoni]].{{ref/book|8|1}}

Several [[Dedicated]], including Sandomere, [[Androl Genhald]], [[Canler]], [[Evin Vinchova]], [[Mezar Kurin]], and [[Welyn Kajima]], meet with [[Logain Ablar]]. Sandomere reports that [[Atal Mishraile]] is receiving private lessons from [[Mazrim Taim]].  [[Toveine Gazal]] doubts that Donalo Sandomere is his real name. {{ref/book|9|prologue}}

Linked, Sandomere and Ayako weave [[Fire]] to incinerate the corpses of [[Trolloc]]s and [[Myrddraal]].{{ref/book|11|20}} They accompany Rand to his meeting with the [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag|Daughter of the Nine Moons]]. Ayako waits a few miles away with the [[Saldaea]]ns and most of the others while Sandomere is one of the six who accompany Rand to Lady [[Deirdru]]'s manor. Afterwards, [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] [[Healing|Heals]] Sandomere's injuries. It is learned that he has been raised to full Asha'man status.{{ref/book|11|27}}

During the [[Last Battle]], Donalo appears again, him and Ayako both having been [[Turning|turned]] to serve the [[Shadow]]. Together with several other Darkfriend channelers, such as [[Alviarin Freidhen]] and [[Atal Mishraile]], he is lured into an [[Ogier]] ''[[stedding]]'' through a clever trick designed by [[Androl Genhald]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]].{{ref/book|14|42}}

He is presumed to be alive and kept a captive in [[Stedding Sholoon|''Stedding'' Sholoon]].
